traditional: 同 A 講返最新情況
jyutping: tung4 A gong2 faan1 zeoi3 san1 cing4 fong3

english.note: Use this when telling a person about recent developments rather than changing the thing itself.

examples.english: I'll update you on the latest situation now.
examples.traditional: 我而家同你講返最新情況。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 tung4 nei5 gong2 faan1 zeoi3 san1 cing4 fong3
